purpose: Authoritative catalog of every Antigravity Language Server (LS) method the Deck currently implements/calls, plus supporting transport and protobuf machinery. Baseline for diffing against the live Antigravity API.

transport.tls: Per-instance useTls flag (HTTPS self-signed OR HTTP plaintext). rejectUnauthorized:false on ALL requests. NOTE (fix #86): Node 18+ native fetch() silently ignores https.Agent, so the codebase uses raw http/https.request() everywhere — NOT fetch().
transport.csrfHeaderCasing: Inconsistent: JSON path uses 'X-Codeium-Csrf-Token', binary path (callApiBinary) uses lowercase 'x-codeium-csrf-token'. Both work (HTTP headers case-insensitive).
transport.protocol: Connect Protocol (Connect-RPC) v1 — NOT gRPC-web. Connect-Protocol-Version: 1 required.
transport.binaryFraming: Per docs/antigravity-api.md: binary uses same path with Content-Type application/proto, 5-byte length-prefixed header [0x00, len_be32]. The Deck's encodeStepsRequest emits a RAW unframed protobuf body (no 5-byte envelope) and it works for GetCascadeTrajectorySteps.

callApi.behavior: Standard JSON RPC. Rejects on statusCode>=400 ('API {code}') or JSON parse error. Resolves parsed JSON.

callApiFireAndForget.behavior: For streaming RPCs that close after processing (HandleCascadeUserInteraction). ECONNRESET / 'socket hang up' treated as SUCCESS ({ok:true,status:0,data:'stream_closed'}). Never rejects.

callApiBinary.behavior: Hardcoded to POST GetCascadeTrajectorySteps with Content-Type application/proto. Body built by encodeStepsRequest(cascadeId,startIndex,endIndex). Resolves raw Buffer (caller decodes via protobuf.js). Used because JSON GetCascadeTrajectorySteps ignores startIndex and caps at ~578-598 steps.

callApiStream.behavior: Server-streaming RPC (SendUserCascadeMessage). Accumulates all chunks, resolves {status,data} when stream ends.

callApiOnInstance / callApiFireAndForget.behavior: Backward-compatible aliases that bind an explicit LS instance: (inst,method,body) => callApi(method,body,inst).

callLsApi.behavior: Standalone JSON caller used during headless LS bootstrap (before instance is registered in lsInstances). Same headers/path format.

connectPost.behavior: Standalone JSON caller used during LS detection/port-probing. Returns a fetch-like shim {ok,status,text(),json()}.

transport.instanceShape: LS instance object: { pid, csrfToken, port, useTls, workspaceId, workspaceName, workspaceFolderUri, category, active, headless? }. resolveConn() in api.js requires port+csrfToken or throws 'Not configured'.

whitelist.gate: src/routes/cascade.js:245-261 — POST /api/ls/:method. Returns 403 'Method not allowed' if method not in set, else callApi(method, req.body, inst).
whitelist.note: This is the ONLY security gate for adding new methods via the generic proxy. Adding a new live-API method to the Deck's generic proxy requires adding it here verbatim. 18 methods.
whitelistAnomalies: GetCascadeTrajectory — whitelisted but never called by any dedicated route/module (only reachable via generic proxy).
GetWorkspaceFolders — whitelisted but Deck code actually calls GetWorkspaceInfos for workspace info; GetWorkspaceFolders is never invoked. Possibly a misnamed/legacy entry.

GetSettings / UpdateSettings — whitelisted but never invoked by Deck LS code (the /api/settings routes operate on local Deck settings.json via config.js, NOT the LS). Reachable only via generic proxy.
StartCascadeInvocation — whitelisted but Deck actually uses StartCascade (no 'Invocation' suffix) for creating cascades. StartCascadeInvocation is never called.
SendCascadeMessage — whitelisted but Deck actually uses SendUserCascadeMessage (streaming) for sending. SendCascadeMessage is never called.
AcceptDiff / RejectDiff — called by agent-session.js but NOT whitelisted (they bypass the proxy; invoked internally via callApi). Would be BLOCKED if attempted through /api/ls/:method.

StartCascade, SendUserCascadeMessage, SaveMediaAsArtifact, AddTrackedWorkspace, GetWorkspaceInfos, GetSubscriptionStatus, StreamCascadeReactiveUpdates — actively used by the Deck via dedicated routes/modules but NOT in the proxy whitelist.

methodCounts.note: catalogedDistinct=22 (the methods[] array). activelyCalledDistinct=21 = unique LS method strings actually passed to callApi*/callLsApi/connectPost across src/ (StartCascade, SendUserCascadeMessage, GetAllCascadeTrajectories, GetCascadeTrajectorySteps, GetCascadeTrajectoryGeneratorMetadata, HandleCascadeUserInteraction, CancelCascadeInvocation, DeleteCascadeTrajectory, GetUserStatus, GetProfileData, GetSubscriptionStatus, GetCascadeModelConfigData, GetAvailableCascadePlugins, InstallCascadePlugin, UninstallCascadePlugin, SaveMediaAsArtifact, AddTrackedWorkspace, GetWorkspaceInfos, StreamCascadeReactiveUpdates, AcceptDiff, RejectDiff). The 22nd cataloged method, GetCascadeTrajectory, is whitelisted-but-never-called. whitelistedAndAlsoCalled=12 = the 18 whitelisted minus the 6 never-called.

protobufCoverage.nature: Hand-reverse-engineered field-number maps. Only decodes the GetCascadeTrajectorySteps binary response (repeated Step at field 1). No .proto schema; uses protobufjs Reader for low-level wire parsing + heuristic string-vs-nested detection (looksLikeString).

encodeStepsRequest.fields: field 1 (cascadeId, wt2/LEN), field 2 (startIndex, wt0/varint), field 3 (endIndex, wt0/varint)

stepMessageWireLayout.other_LEN_fields: content payload keyed by CONTENT_FIELD_MAP -> decodeGenericMessage with NESTED_FIELD_MAPS

STEP_TYPE_MAP.confidence: medium — derived by cross-referencing JSON and binary responses; unmapped IDs render as CORTEX_STEP_TYPE_UNKNOWN_{id}
STEP_TYPE_MAP.note: Docs reference additional step types not in the binary map (GREP_SEARCH, FIND, ERROR as a type). build-interaction also handles OPEN_BROWSER_URL/BROWSER_ACTION by name but those type IDs are not in STEP_TYPE_MAP.

STEP_STATUS_MAP.confidence: high for 9=WAITING (confirmed from live LS for CODE_ACTION+RUN_COMMAND); others medium

NESTED_FIELD_MAPS.confidence: low-medium — 'Auto-discovered nested field name mappings (from cross-referencing JSON and binary responses)'. Partial per-message; unmapped fields fall back to numeric keys (e.g. codeAction['25'], codeAction['1'] are read by number in auto-accept.js).
NESTED_FIELD_MAPS.note: These maps cover ONLY fields the Deck needs to render/extract content + build accept interactions. Many real fields are absent. plannerResponse.toolCalls and plannerResponse.content[].text are referenced in JS but not in the nested map (they appear in JSON responses, not binary-decoded ones).

protobufCoverage.exports: encodeVarint, encodeStepsRequest, countBinarySteps, decodeBinarySteps, decodeStepMessage, decodeMetadata, decodeTimestamp, decodeGenericMessage, looksLikeString, STEP_TYPE_MAP, STEP_STATUS_MAP, CONTENT_FIELD_MAP, NESTED_FIELD_MAPS

methods.name: StartCascade
methods.notes: Creates a new conversation. Workspace bound by the LS instance connection, not a request field. NOTE: whitelist has 'StartCascadeInvocation' instead — that name is never used.

methods.name: SendUserCascadeMessage
methods.reqShape: { metadata:{}, cascadeId, items:[{text}], cascadeConfig:{ plannerConfig:{ plannerTypeConfig:{case:'conversational',value:{}}, planModel:modelId, requestedModel:{modelId} } }, media?:[{mimeType,inlineData,uri,thumbnail}] }
methods.respShape: server stream of JSON lines (accumulated; not parsed by Deck — fire-and-forget semantics, polling picks up steps)
methods.notes: Default modelId 'MODEL_PLACEHOLDER_M26'. Both planModel (string) AND requestedModel (object) required per docs. Called via callApiStream (120s). NOTE: whitelist has 'SendCascadeMessage' instead — that name is never used.

methods.name: GetAllCascadeTrajectories
methods.respShape: { trajectorySummaries: { <cascadeId>: { summary, stepCount, lastModifiedTime, trajectoryId, status, createdTime, workspaces:[{workspaceFolderAbsoluteUri, gitRootAbsoluteUri, repository, branchName}], lastUserInputTime, lastUserInputStepIndex, latestNotifyUserStep, latestTaskBoundaryStep } } }
methods.notes: Most heavily used method — the core polling/listing primitive. Used for status, stepCount, trajectoryId lookup, and workspace filtering.

methods.name: GetCascadeTrajectory
methods.notes: Whitelisted but NEVER called by dedicated code — reachable only via generic /api/ls/ proxy.

methods.name: GetCascadeTrajectorySteps
methods.respShape: json: { steps:[{type,status,metadata,<contentKey>}] } | binary: repeated Step (field 1), decoded by protobuf.js
methods.notes: KNOWN LS BUG: JSON variant ignores startIndex (always returns from 0) and caps at ~578-598 steps. Deck works around this with binary protobuf (callApiBinary) for pagination and high-index tail fetches. detectApiStartIndex() compensates for the ignored startIndex.

methods.name: GetCascadeTrajectoryGeneratorMetadata
methods.respShape: { generatorMetadata:[{ stepIndices:[..], chatModel:{ model, usage:{ inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, apiProvider } } }] }
methods.notes: Token usage per step. Exposed via GET /api/cascade/:id/metadata.

methods.name: HandleCascadeUserInteraction
methods.reqShape: { cascadeId, interaction:{ trajectoryId, stepIndex, <one of: filePermission{allow,scope,absolutePathUri} | runCommand{confirm,proposedCommandLine,submittedCommandLine} | codeAction{confirm} | sendCommandInput{confirm,proposedInput,submittedInput} | browserAction{confirm} | confirm:bool> } }
methods.notes: Accept/reject pending agent actions. Streaming RPC — uses callApiFireAndForget. Reject = flip allow->false / confirm->false / drop scope. Interaction payload built by buildInteraction() in auto-accept.js per step type. scope values: PERMISSION_SCOPE_ONCE (code) — docs also mention SESSION / ALL_CURRENT_AND_FUTURE.

methods.name: CancelCascadeInvocation
methods.notes: Cancel active invocation. Exposed via POST /api/cascade/:id/cancel. (Called via callApi, not fire-and-forget, despite docs flow describing it as streaming.)

methods.name: DeleteCascadeTrajectory
methods.notes: Delete a conversation. Exposed via DELETE /api/cascade/:id; also triggers local cleanupCascade().

methods.name: GetUserStatus
methods.respShape: { userStatus:{ name, email, planStatus:{ planInfo:{ teamsTier, planName, maxNumPremiumChatMessages, monthlyPromptCredits, monthlyFlowCredits, browserEnabled, knowledgeBaseEnabled }, availablePromptCredits, availableFlowCredits }, userTier:{id,name}, acceptedLatestTermsOfService, cascadeModelConfigData } }
methods.notes: Full user info + plan + models. ALSO used as the canonical liveness/port-detection probe endpoint by detector.js (connectPost) and headless-ls.js (findApiPort).

methods.name: GetProfileData
methods.notes: Base64 profile picture. Combined with GetUserStatus in GET /api/user/profile.

methods.name: GetSubscriptionStatus
methods.notes: Used for profile/account onboarding metadata (email/tier/plan detection). NOT whitelisted (only used internally via profiles routes). Not documented in antigravity-api.md.

methods.name: GetCascadeModelConfigData
methods.respShape: { clientModelConfigs:[{ label, modelOrAlias:{model|alias}, supportsImages, isRecommended, quotaInfo:{remainingFraction,resetTime}, supportedMimeTypes }], clientModelSorts:[...], defaultOverrideModelConfig:{modelOrAlias:{model}} }
methods.notes: Full model config + quotas. Exposed via GET /api/models. (docs note GetCascadeModelConfigs returns empty — use this one.)

methods.name: GetAvailableCascadePlugins
methods.respShape: { plugins:[{ name, description, ... }] } (~43 plugins per docs)
methods.notes: Exposed via GET /api/plugins.

methods.name: InstallCascadePlugin
methods.notes: Exposed via POST /api/plugins/install.

methods.name: UninstallCascadePlugin
methods.notes: Exposed via DELETE /api/plugins/:id. NOTE: not documented in antigravity-api.md (docs only list Install).

methods.name: SaveMediaAsArtifact
methods.notes: Image/media upload. Exposed via POST /api/media/save. Result media[] then attached to SendUserCascadeMessage. NOT whitelisted.

methods.name: AddTrackedWorkspace
methods.reqShape: { workspace: '<plain path, forward-slashes, NOT file:// URI>' }
methods.notes: Binds a workspace folder to an LS instance so cascades route correctly. CRITICAL for headless LS and IDE-launched workspace creation. Field is 'workspace' with a plain path (docs incorrectly say 'workspaceUri'). NOT whitelisted.

methods.name: GetWorkspaceInfos
methods.notes: Resolves a workspace's folder URI + name. Used during detection (getWorkspaceInfo) and headless verification. NOT whitelisted. NOTE: the whitelist has 'GetWorkspaceFolders' which is a different (never-called) name.

methods.name: StreamCascadeReactiveUpdates
methods.respShape: streaming JSON lines; Deck reads { status|cascadeStatus, cascadeId|conversationId } for instant status-change detection
methods.notes: Long-lived server stream subscribed at startup (startCascadeSSE) for instant WAITING_FOR_USER detection, supplementing the poller. Auto-retries after 10s on error. Raw http/https.request stream (not fetch). NOT whitelisted.

methods.name: AcceptDiff
methods.notes: Accept code changes for a cascade. Used by AgentSession (Discord/WS/HTTP agent bridge) accept()/_triggerAccept(). NOT whitelisted — would be BLOCKED via generic proxy. Not documented in antigravity-api.md.

methods.name: RejectDiff
methods.notes: Reject code changes for a cascade. Used by AgentSession reject()/_triggerReject(). NOT whitelisted. Not documented in antigravity-api.md.

docsCoverage.note: docs/antigravity-api.md is the master reverse-engineered catalog (tested 2026-02-28). It documents ~120 LS methods across 12 categories — the VAST MAJORITY are documented-but-NOT-implemented by the Deck. This is the richest source for the diff: known method names the live API exposes that the Deck does not call. Mission-named methods (StreamAgentStateUpdates, GetTurnDiff, JetboxWriteState) do NOT appear in any doc — confirming they are newer than this catalog.

docs/antigravity-api.md.documents: Master catalog. Connection (path/headers/csrf). 12 method groups with status flags (✓ confirmed / ✗ error / ? untested). Step types, step statuses, cascade run statuses. Binary protobuf framing note (5-byte [0x00,len_be32] header). Windows pagination bug. Generic proxy endpoint.
docs/antigravity-api.md.documentedButNotImplemented: Nearly all of the above except the 11 the Deck actively calls. Notably documented-yet-unused: GetUserTrajectoryDescriptions, GetWorkspaceEditState (git diff state), GetStaticExperimentStatus (feature flags), GetCascadeNuxes, Heartbeat, WellSupportedLanguages, GetMcpServerStates, GetBrowserOpenConversation, all Streaming methods except StreamCascadeReactiveUpdates.
docs/antigravity-api.md.discrepancies: Docs mark HandleCascadeUserInteraction/CancelCascadeInvocation/DeleteCascadeTrajectory/InstallCascadePlugin as '?' (untested) though the Deck uses them. Docs do NOT mention SaveMediaAsArtifact, GetSubscriptionStatus, AcceptDiff, RejectDiff, UninstallCascadePlugin (all used by Deck). Docs list SmartOpenBrowser but UninstallCascadePlugin missing.

Documents the generic /api/ls/:method proxy. Step types reference.
